chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar asked his brother Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام.
About a man: is it permissible for him to perform salat (prayer) while in front of him there is a rack upon which there are clothes?
So he said: “There is no harm.”

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible
key_terms.مِشْجَبٌ: a rack or stand on which clothes are hung

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) with a clothes rack in front of you?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning salat (prayer) and what may be present in front of a person during prayer. Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that there is no harm in praying while a clothes rack with garments on it is in front of the worshipper.
